title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1285 Emancipation Highway in Fredericksburg, Virginia, as the "Gladys P. Todd Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 1285 Emancipation Highway in Fredericksburg, Virginia, as the Gladys P. Todd Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress renamed a Postal Service facility in Fredericksburg, Virginia, as the Gladys P. Todd Post Office.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service building at 1285 Emancipation Highway in Fredericksburg, Virginia, a new official name. The building will be called the Gladys P. Todd Post Office. The law does not change mail service, postal rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
